title: Atlas User Mapping Pack
description: Validation schema for Atlas community and vendor mapping packs.

name.description: Unique identifier for the mapping pack (e.g. siemens-s7-1500, fanuc-31i).

vendor.description: Controller manufacturer (e.g. Siemens, Fanuc, Mitsubishi, Beckhoff).

model.description: Target CNC/PLC controller family or model line.

rules.description: Ordered list of regex mapping rules evaluated against discovered tags.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched against NodeId, BrowseName, or BrowsePath.

label.description: Standardized semantic metric identifier (e.g. spindle_speed, parts_produced).

unit.description: Engineering unit (e.g. rpm, bar, °C, mm/min, s, total).

scale.description: Optional numeric multiplier to scale raw integer registers (e.g. 0.01 for centi-degrees).

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the tag's operational meaning.
